description.sub_name: 振動與噪音原理與量測
description.sub_ename: PRINCIPLE AND MEASUREMENT OF VIBRATION AND NOISE
description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹噪音與振動控制的基本原理與量測方法。噪音控制涵蓋噪音源能量之降低（即減少振動量）與聲音傳遞路徑之阻絕。欲執行有效率之噪音控制必須針對噪音場之量測、音場預測與分析、隔音材料之使用有正確之瞭解。針對機械振動所造成之噪音，本課程介紹改變機械設計降低振動與避免共振的方法，藉由減振設計以降低噪音源。
description.describe_eh: The objective of this course is to introduce the basic principles and measurements of vibration and noise control which involves reduction of energy that a noise source converts to sound power and the interruption of sound transmission paths. Noise control may require measurements and analysis of the existing environments, prediction and modeling of the noise field.
description.pre_sub_ename: ENGS2010 ENGINEERING MATHEMATICS、EAR6024 FUNDAMENTALS OF ACOUSTICS

targets.describe_ch: 能清楚瞭解與分析簡單的音場與機械振動與確認噪音源之主頻率與噪音頻譜。
targets.describe_en: Understand and analyze simple sound field and mechanical vibration and determine the dominant frequencies and the spectral shape of common noise sources.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解機械噪音特性及其位準對人體健康之影響。
targets.describe_en: Determine the effects of the level and the character of sound emitted by machinery and other sources on human behavior and safety.

targets.describe_ch: 可利用現代數位訊號儀器進行噪音振動量測與分析。
targets.describe_en: Perform sound and vibration measurements and data analysis using modern instrumentation and signal processing technology.

targets.describe_ch: 能針對噪音問題提出實用與經濟之解決方案。
targets.describe_en: Find practical and economical solutions to noise control engineering.
